title: Running the test suite in a container, exactly like the pipeline

videos.script: A test that passes on one machine and fails in the pipeline is lesson one's problem again. This lesson runs the tests in containers. {{toolchain}} First, the same Go everywhere: the golang image, with the source mounted. {{stage}} Then the tests as a stage of the Dockerfile. Asked for by name, they run. A normal build skips them. And a broken test stops the build before an image exists. {{integration}} Last, a test against a real Postgres, started by Compose for the run and thrown away after. The exit code is what the pipeline reads.
